name: Luang Prabang

deep.seasons: Best Nov-Feb (cool, dry, festival season). Mar-Apr burning-season haze. May-Oct is green and wet.
deep.airports: LPQ (direct from Bangkok, Hanoi, Chiang Mai, Siem Reap)
deep.notes: UNESCO peninsula between the Mekong and Nam Khan. Dawn alms (5:30am) is the ritual — watch respectfully from across the street. Night market and Mount Phousi sunset bookend each day.

docs.entry: Laos visa on arrival ($30-42 cash) or e-visa ($35-50) at laoevisa.gov.la; 30 days.
docs.insurance: Get cover including boat trips; hospitals are basic locally.
special: Bring crisp USD cash for visa on arrival — cards not accepted
ATM fees are high (~$2-3 per withdrawal)
docs.agency: No agency needed — e-visa portal is official.

bestMonths: Best Nov, Dec, Jan, Feb (cool and dry, festival season). Mar-Apr burning-season haze. May-Oct is green and wet.
crowd: Quiet temple town; Nov-Feb high season brings tour groups to alms and falls, still calm at dawn.
